headline: Executive order aimed at ending what it calls illegal discrimination and promoting merit-based opportunity.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs action against practices it treats as illegal discrimination and calls for opportunities to be based on merit. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, programs, and groups it covers cannot be confirmed from this source.
when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 21, 2025; the effective dates of specific provisions are not stated in the material provided.
